help.category.crm.title: CRM & Contacts
help.category.crm.content:
Relationship Management

Vysify CRM allows you to manage all your customers in one place.

  • Contacts: Add individuals with email, phone, and professional titles.
  • Companies: Group contacts under organizations for a B2B view.
  • Activities: Log notes, emails, and calls directly on the contact profile.

Tip: Use the quick search bar at the top to find any customer instantly.
help.category.pipelines.title: Sales Pipelines
help.category.pipelines.content:
Kanban Pipeline

Visualize the progress of your deals through intuitive columns.

  • Deals: Represent sales opportunities. Drag and drop between columns to change stages.
  • Stages: Each column represents a step in your sales process (e.g., Lead, Proposal, Closed).
  • Priority: Mark deals as High, Medium, or Low priority to focus on what matters.
help.category.inbox.title: Inbox & Messages
help.category.inbox.content:
Shared Inbox

Centralize all your communications in one place.

  • Omnichannel: Receive messages from WhatsApp, email, and site chat on a single screen.
  • Assignment: Delegate conversations to specific team members.
  • Internal Notes: Comment on conversations to align strategies with colleagues without the customer seeing.
help.category.tasks.title: Tasks
help.category.tasks.content:
Activity Management

Never miss a follow-up or important appointment.

  • Deal Tasks: Link tasks directly to a Deal to keep the sales process warm.
  • Reminders: Set due dates and receive notifications before the deadline.
  • Filters: View only your pending tasks or see the progress of the entire team.
help.category.custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
help.category.custom_fields.content:
Adapt the System to your SME

Don't get stuck with generic fields. Create your own data structure.

  • Field Types: Text, Number, Selection, Multiselect, Checkbox, Currency, URL, and Phone.
  • Mandatory: Define which fields are essential for saving a record.
  • Stage Validation: (Coming soon) Require specific data only when a deal reaches a certain stage.

Setup at: Settings > Workspace > Custom Fields.
help.category.automations.title: Automations & SLA
help.category.automations.content:
autopilot Productivity

Create rules that work for you 24/7.

  • Lead Routing: Automatically assign conversations to team members based on conditions.
  • SLA Alerts: Get notified if a customer is not answered within the time limit (e.g., 15 min).
  • Triggers: New contact, incoming message, funnel stage change.
help.category.analytics.title: Analytics & Insights
help.category.analytics.content:
Data for Decision Making

Understand the health of your business through real-time indicators.

  • Conversion Funnel: See at which stage of the pipeline you are losing most deals.
  • Team Performance: Compare response time and closing rate between sellers.
  • Predictability: Estimate your future revenue based on open deals and their probabilities.
help.category.integrations.title: Integrations & Webhooks
help.category.integrations.content:
Connect your Tools

Vysify is born connected with major platforms.

  • WhatsApp: Receive and send messages directly from the inbox.
  • Webhooks: Send data to Zapier or Make whenever something happens in the CRM.
  • Delivery Dashboard: Monitor if your webhooks were delivered successfully and retry in case of failure.
help.category.presets.title: 1-Click Setups
help.category.presets.content:
Industry Presets

Get started in seconds with tested settings for your market.

  • Real Estate: Visit funnel and fields for property type.
  • Clinics: Appointments and basic medical record fields.
  • Agencies: Proposal management and recurrence.

Tip: You can apply a preset and then customize every detail.
help.category.billing.title: Billing & Subscriptions
help.category.billing.content:
Managing your Plan

Control your costs and available resources transparently.

  • Plan Upgrade: Move to Pro or Enterprise plan as your company grows.
  • Invoice History: Download your invoices and payment receipts.
  • Resource Usage: Track how many users, contacts, and webhooks you still have available for the month.
help.category.team.title: Team Management
help.category.team.content:
Secure Collaboration

Manage who has access to what within your organization.

  • Invitations: Send email invitations to new team members.
  • Roles: Define if the user is an Admin or Common Member to restrict access to sensitive settings.
  • Activity Logs: (Coming soon) See who changed what in contact and deal records.
help.category.ai_context.title: AI Training
help.category.ai_context.content:
Business Context

For the AI to be efficient, it needs to know your company.

  • What to include: Description of your products/services, target audience, tone of voice, and competitive advantages.
  • Benefits: More accurate suggested replies, smarter conversation summaries, and personalized pipeline insights.

Setup at: Settings > General > AI Business Context.
help.category.nps.title: NPS & Automation
help.category.nps.content:
Satisfaction Surveys

Measure and improve your customers' experience automatically.

  • Automatic Triggers: Configure automations to send surveys when a deal is Won or after a conversation.
  • Channels: Send via WhatsApp or Email to ensure high response rates.
  • Analysis: Track your NPS Score (0-10) in real-time on the Analytics dashboard.
